title: Things A Little Bird Told Me

questions.q: What does Biz Stone say limits do for creativity?
questions.why: The book states limits automatically force you to be creative.

questions.q: How many years did Biz Stone spend in cycles of failure before Twitter?
questions.why: He mentions ten years of trying before founding Twitter.

questions.q: What was the initial source for Biz's first Twitter logo sketch?
questions.why: He sketched a bird based on an image he found online.

questions.q: What does Biz believe about ideas after they are released?
a: They should stay open to change
questions.why: He says ideas rarely enter the world fully formed and stay open to changes.

questions.q: According to the book, what fuels motivation when facing frustration?
questions.why: Frustration is described as a great source of motivation.
